metadataReview.note: Replace the isolated 27 May 1915 catalogue date with the official 15–25 May 1915 bounds published by Canada’s Department of National Defence for the Battle of Festubert. These are full battle dates, not the narrower 17–25 May period of Canadian participation in other national chronologies. The CDB90 row spans 16–26 May instead and remains excluded; this correction does not approve its force quantities.
